transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in today?

Um... I guess I'm just here because... I've been feeling pretty low. For a couple of years now, really. It's just... this heavy, empty feeling. It doesn't really go away, even when I'm at work or church... or around people. It just kind of stays.
Have you noticed a loss of pleasure or interest in activities that you used to enjoy?
Um... no, not really. I mean, I still do the things I normally do. I don't think I've stopped liking them... I just... I'm not sure.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep, appetite, or energy levels along with this feeling of being low?

Um... I guess my sleep is off. I'll be exhausted after standing on the production floor all day... but when I get in bed, my mind just keeps running. Just about... everything I'm behind on. And if I do fall asleep, I just wake up feeling like I barely rested.
Have you found yourself feeling worthless or guilty about things you’ve done—or haven’t done—lately?
Um... I don't know if I'd call it worthless. I just... I think about things I should be doing better. But... I don't know. I guess everyone feels like that sometimes.
Can you think of a time recently when you genuinely looked forward to something or felt enjoyment in doing it?
Um... I don't know. I guess I look forward to my days off so I don't have to be on my feet all day. But... I don't know if that's what you mean. I just... I don't really know.
When you're feeling low, does your mood stay pretty much the same every day, or does it get a little better or worse depending on what's happening around you?
Um... I don't really pay attention to it that much. It's just... kind of always there, I guess. I don't know if things happening change it. It's just... the same.
Looking back, have you noticed that you don't enjoy things as much as you used to, or that you've lost interest in activities you once looked forward to?
Um... I'm not really sure. I don't... I can't really remember what I used to do. I mostly just go to work and come home, so... I haven't really noticed a change, I guess. I just don't do much anyway.
Have there been times when you felt a little better for a few days or weeks, or has the low feeling been pretty much constant over the past couple of years?

Um... it's pretty much constant. I guess it's been like this for... maybe two years and some change. Four months, maybe. Ever since I had to drop out of my community college classes. I just... didn't have the money, and it was too hard with my work schedule. So... yeah, it's just been the same since then.

When you're feeling low, does your mood ever lift even a little when something good happens, like seeing a friend or finishing a task, or does it stay the same regardless of what’s going on around you?
Um... I don't really know. I guess... it just stays the same. I don't really see friends that much anyway, so... I don't know. It's just flat, I guess.
Have you ever had a period lasting at least two months where your mood was better—maybe not completely normal, but noticeably improved—before this current two-year stretch?
Um... no. I don't think so. I can't really remember a time when it was... better. It just feels like it's always been this way, I guess.
